description: This file defines an Angular standalone CardComponent that provides a reusable UI card with optional header and footer, styled via internal CSS and supporting accessibility features.

classes.name: CardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component representing a UI card with optional header and footer slots, customizable via inputs, with associated styles for layout and theme.

methods.name: titleId
methods.description: Optional ID for the title element used by aria-labelledby on the card region.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Boolean indicating whether the header slot is used.

methods.name: hasFooter
methods.description: Boolean indicating whether the footer slot is used.
